10001.name: Thrust
10001.description: Push the point of your weapon into enemies, performing a strong piercing attack.

attributes.name: Thrust: Continuous Attack
attributes.effect: Activates consecutive attacks when using [Thrust] by 1% chance per attribute level.

attributes.name: Thrust: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Thrust] by 1% per attribute level.

attributes.name: Thrust: Bleeding
attributes.effect: Inflicts [Bleeding] on stunned enemies for 5 seconds with [Thrust]. Bleeding damage is proportional to the character's STR.

10002.name: Bash
10002.description: Inflict damage on an enemy with a powerful attack.

attributes.name: Bash: Knockdown
attributes.effect: Enemies hit by [Bash] are knocked down.

attributes.name: Bash: Splash
attributes.effect: Increases the AoE Attack Ratio of [Bash] by 1 per attribute level.

attributes.name: Bash: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Bash] by 1% per attribute level.

attributes.name: Bash: Specialty
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt with [Bash] by 28 per attribute level.

10003.name: Gung Ho
10003.description: Become determined by temporarily increasing your attack, while decreasing your defense.

attributes.name: Gung Ho: Enhance
attributes.effect: Amplifies the physical damage increase effect and the decreased defense effect of [Gung Ho] by 1 per attribute level.

attributes.name: Concentrate: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the additional damage of [Concentrate] by 2 per attribute level.

10005.name: Pain Barrier
10005.description: Temporarily grants a high resistance to being affected by knock back, knock down or staggered.

10006.name: Restrain
10006.description: Lowers your maximum HP, but your attacks have a high chance of stunning enemies.

attributes.name: Restrain: Slow
attributes.effect: Enemies stunned by [Restrain] become slowed after the stun wears off. Increases the duration of the slow effect by 3 seconds per attribute level.

10007.name: Pommel Beat
10007.description:
Strike enemies with the hilt of your sword.
Inflicts additional damage on stunned monsters, and partially ignores the defense of small and medium sized enemies.

attributes.name: Pommel Beat: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Pommel Beat] by 1% per attribute level.

10008.name: Double Slash
10008.description:
Perform a side slash on enemies.
Enemies afflicted with [Bleeding] take additional damage.

attributes.name: Double Slash: Critical
attributes.effect: Increases the critical chance of [Double Slash] by 7% per attribute level.

attributes.name: Double Slash: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Double Slash] by 1% per attribute level.

10101.name: Umbo Blow
10101.description: Use the bump of your shield to attack enemies. Deals additional damage to enemies staggered by a block.

attributes.name: Umbo Blow: Stun
attributes.effect: Enemies hit by [Umbo Blow] have a 5% chance per attribute level to become afflicted with [Stun] for 3 seconds.

attributes.name: Umbo Blow: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Umbo Blow] by 1% per attribute level.

attributes.name: [Umbo Blow]: Add Knockdown
attributes.effect: Enemies hit by [Umbo Blow] will fall down, increases the knockdown power by 40 per attribute level.

10102.name: Rim Blow
10102.description: Use the edge of your shield to attack enemies. Inflicts additional damage on both petrified and frozen enemies.

attributes.name: Rim Blow: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Rim Blow] by 1% per attribute level.

10103.name: Swash Buckling
10103.required_stance: OneHandSwordShield OneHandSpearShield OneHandSwordDagger OneHandSpearDagger RapierAndShield RapierAndDagger
10103.description: Hit your shield to provoke nearby enemies making them pursue you.

attributes.name: Swash Buckling: Maximum HP
attributes.effect: Increases the character's maximum HP by 5% per attribute level when [Swash Buckling] is active.

10104.name: Guardian
10104.description: Increases your defense while decreasing your attack. Cannot be used with Gung Ho.

attributes.name: Guardian: Evasion
attributes.effect: Increases the character's evasion by 6% per attribute level when [Guardian] is active.

10105.name: Shield Lob
10105.description: Attack an enemy by throwing your shield. Your shield drops on the targeted area, and your physical defense decreases based on the value of the equipment. The shield may be picked up or it'll automatically return to your inventory after a certain time. The decreased physical defense will return back to normal once your shield is back in the inventory.

attributes.name: Shield Lob: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Shield Lob] by 1% per attribute level.

attributes.name: Shield Lob: Splash
attributes.effect: Increases your AoE attack ratio of [Shield Lob] by 1 per attribute level.

10106.name: High Guard

attributes.name: High Guard: Increased Defense
attributes.effect: Increases your defense by 1 per attribute level when using [High Guard].

attributes.name: High Guard: Rim Blow Speciality
attributes.effect: Applies your damage of [Rim Blow] to 250% when using [High Guard]. From Lv2, damage increases by 20% per attribute level.

attributes.name: High Guard: Umbo Blow Speciality
attributes.effect: Applies your damage of [Umbo Blow] to 250% when using [High Guard]. From Lv2, damage increases by 20% per attribute level.

10107.name: Butterfly

attributes.name: Butterfly: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Butterfly] by 1% per attribute level.

10108.name: Umbo Thrust

attributes.name: Umbo Thrust: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Umbo Thrust] by 1% per attribute level.

10109.name: Langort

10201.name: Wagon Wheel

attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Wagon Wheel] by 1% per attribute level.

attributes.effect: Increases the AoE Attack Ratio of [Wagon Wheel] by 1.

10202.name: Cartar Stroke

10203.name: Crown

10204.name: Cross Guard

10205.name: Moulinet

attributes.name: Moulinet: Critical

10206.name: Skull Swing

10207.name: Skyliner
10207.description:
Slash the enemy sideways.

attributes.name: Skyliner: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Skyliner] by 1% per attribute level.

10208.name: Crosscut

attributes.name: Crosscut: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Crosscut] by 1% per attribute level.

10209.name: Vertical Slash
10209.description: Attack with a descending vertical slash. Deals additional damage on medium and large-type enemies according to how much their defense has been decreased by [Skull Swing]. 10301.name: Stabbing

10302.name: Pierce

10303.name: Finestra

11008.name: Zucken
11008.description: Inflict damage on a frontal enemy through a series of lateral slashes. Deals additional damage to enemies afflicted with [Shock].

attributes.name: Zucken: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Zucken] by 1% per attribute level.

11101.name: Attaque Composee
11101.description: [Physical] - [Pierce]Stab an enemy in front of you.

attributes.name: Attaque Composee: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Attaque Composee] by 1% per attribute level.

11102.name: Lunge
11102.description: [Physical] - [Pierce]Lower your stance and reach out to attack an enemy. Your evasion rate increases and the enemy becomes more vulnerable to [Slash] attacks.

attributes.name: Lunge: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Lunge] by 1% per attribute level.

attributes.name: Sept Etoiles: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Sept Etoiles] by 1% per attribute level.

11104.name: Attaque Coquille
11104.description: [Physical] - [Strike]Attack an enemy with the guard of your sword. The enemy's defense is ignored when attacked again with [Pierce] attacks.

attributes.name: Attaque Coquille: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Attaque Coquille] by 1% per attribute level.

11105.name: Esquive Toucher
11105.description: [Physical] - [Pierce]Move swiftly to avoid enemy attacks and deliver complex successive attacks.

attributes.name: Esquive Toucher: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Esquive Toucher] by 1% per attribute level.

11106.name: Preparation
11106.description: Twirl the tip of your sword to parry an enemy attack and prepare for the next attack. The next [Pierce] attack you make will inflict twice as much damage.

11107.name: Flanconnade
11107.description: [Physical] - [Slash]Perform a complex upward attack with your rapier. This attack protects you against an enemy attack.

attributes.name: Flanconnade: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Flanconnade] by 1% per attribute level.

11201.name: Mijin no Jutsu
11201.description: Attack enemies in the area nearby by exploding the gunpowder you have. Using this technique will also damage you and might cause incapability of combat if your HP is too low.

attributes.name: Mijin no Jutsu: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Mijin no Jutsu] by 1% per attribute level.

attributes.name: Mijin no Jutsu: Stealth
attributes.effect: Your character will hide for 5 seconds after using [Mijin no Jutsu]. Increases the duration from Lv2 by 1.5 seconds per attribute level.

11202.name: Bunshin no Jutsu
11202.description: Creates clones of yourself. The clones will act along as a main body and skills can be used along with your clones. The HP of your clones is determined by your DEX.

attributes.name: Bunshin no Jutsu: Endurance
attributes.effect: Increases the Stamina reduction cycle of [Bunshin no Jutsu] by 0.05 seconds per attribute level.

attributes.name: Bunshin no Jutsu: Decreased Damage
attributes.effect: Decreases damage taken by 4% per attribute level when there are at least 2 clones from [Bunshin no Jutsu].

11203.name: Mokuton no Jutsu
11203.description: Counter-attack by tricking the enemy with a fake doll created from a log.

attributes.name: Mokuton no Jutsu: Bind
attributes.effect: Restricts movement of an enemy for 4 seconds when dealing damage with [Mokuton no Jutsu]. Increases the duration from Lv2 by 1 second per attribute level.

11204.name: Katon no Jutsu
11204.description: Attack multiple enemies by continuously exploding the gunpowder you possess.

attributes.name: Katon no Jutsu: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Katon no Jutsu] by 1% per attribute level.

attributes.name: Katon no Jutsu: Stealth
attributes.effect: Your character will hide for 2 seconds per attribute level after using [Katon no Jutsu].

11205.name: Kunai
11205.description: Attack multiple enemies by throwing a kunai.

attributes.name: Kunai: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Kunai] by 1% per attribute level.

11401.name: Dragontooth
11401.description: Rotate your spear using centrifugal force to attack an enemy.

attributes.name: Dragontooth: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Dragontooth] by 1% per attribute level.

11402.name: Serpentine
11402.description: Use your spear to deal continuous damage to enemies in front of you.

attributes.name: Serpentine: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Serpentine] by 1% per attribute level.

attributes.name: Serpentine: Bleeding
attributes.effect: Enemies hit by [Serpentine] have a 2% chance per attribute level to become afflicted with [Bleeding] for 8 seconds. Bleeding damage is proportional to the character's physical attack.

11403.name: Gae Bulg
11403.description: Attack several enemies within a radius by throwing a spear. Damaged enemies will temporarily become weaker to physical property attacks. The thrown spear must be picked up to use it again.

attributes.name: Gae Bulg: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Gae Bulg] by 1% per attribute level.

attributes.name: Gae Bulg: Defense Zone
attributes.effect: Creates a defense zone for 15 seconds where the spear is thrown. Increases physical defense and magic defense by 2% for party members within the zone.

attributes.name: Gae Bulg: Attack Zone
attributes.effect: Creates an attack zone for 15 seconds where the spear is thrown. Increases physical attack and magic attack by 2% for party members within the zone.

11404.name: Dragon Soar
11404.description: Vault into the air while swinging your spear upwards. Enemies hit with this skill are temporarily launched into the air.

attributes.name: Dragon Soar: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Dragon Soar] by 1% per attribute level.

attributes.name: Dragon Soar: Shock
attributes.effect: Enemies hit by [Dragon Soar] have a 5% chance per attribute level to be afflicted with [Shock] for 10 seconds.

11501.name: Summon Guild Member
11501.description: Summons a specific guild member to your location. You need permission from the specific guild member.

11502.name: Warp To Guild Member
11502.description: Warps to a specific guild member's location. You cannot warp to guild members who are in an instanced dungeon.

11503.name: Build Guild Tower
11503.description:
1레벨: 워프 이용 가능
2레벨: 창고 사용 가능
3레벨: 길드 성장 가능
4레벨: 길드이벤트 이용 가능
5레벨: 길드아지트 가능

11504.name: Reduce Craft Time
11504.description: Plant a flag that reduces the crafting time of all guild members in the area nearby. This can only be used nearby a Guild Tower.

11505.name: Battle Orders
11505.description: Temporarily increases STR of guild members nearby the guild master. This effect disappears if the guild master is too far away.

20001.name: Energy Bolt
20001.description: Gather powerful magical energy to launch it towards an enemy. Increases the inflicted damage depending on the amount of gathered energy.

attributes.name: Energy Bolt: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Energy Bolt] by 1% per attribute level.

attributes.name: Energy Bolt: Additional Sleep Damage
attributes.effect: Deals additional damage equal to 40% magic attack per attribute level when attacking an enemy under [Sleep] with [Energy Bolt].

attributes.name: Lethargy: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the physical and magic attack debuff effect of [Lethargy] by 1 per attribute level.

attributes.name: Lethargy: Additional Damage
attributes.effect: Enemies affected by [Lethargy] receive 20% additional damage per attribute level with [Strike] attacks.

20003.name: Sleep
20003.description: Makes an enemy fall asleep. The enemy awakens once you've reached your limit of attacks.

20004.name: Reflect Shield
20004.description: Creates a protective shield that reflects the amplified damage back to an enemy.

attributes.name: Reflect Shield: Reflect Damage
attributes.effect: Increases reflect damage of [Reflect Shield] by 1 per attribute level and decreases damage received accordingly.

20005.name: Earthquake
20005.description: Inflicts damage on an enemy by creating a powerful earthquake in front of you.

attributes.name: Earthquake: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Earthquake] by 1% per attribute level.

20006.name: Surespell
20006.description: Skills being cast cannot be interrupted by enemy attacks.

20007.name: Magic Missile
20007.description: Attack continuously with magic bullets. New bullets are shot if it successfully targets an enemy.

attributes.name: Magic Missile: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Magic Missile] by 1% per attribute level.

20008.name: Quick Cast
20008.description: Reduces the casting time of skills.

attributes.name: Quick Cast: Magic Damage
attributes.effect: Increases magic damage by 10% per attribute level while [Quick Cast] is active.

20101.name: Fireball
20101.description: Summons a fireball. Enemies touching the fireball will receive continuous flame damage.

attributes.name: Fireball: Burn Debuff
attributes.effect: Enemies hit by [Fireball] have a 10% chance per attribute level to receive flame damage  for 5 seconds. Flame damage is based on the character's INT.

attributes.name: Fireball: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Fireball] by 1% per attribute level.

20102.name: Fire Wall
20102.description: Creates a wall of flames that continuously damages approaching enemies.

attributes.name: Fire Wall: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Fire Wall] by 1% per attribute level.

attributes.name: Fire Wall: Increased Fire Property Buff
attributes.effect: Increases the Fire property attack of an ally by 5 per attribute level for 5 seconds when they step on [Fire Wall].

20103.name: Enchant Fire
20103.description: Temporarily grants the Fire property to you and your party member's attacks.

attributes.name: Enchant Fire: Decreased Fire Property Resistance
attributes.effect: Decreases the Fire property resistance of nearby enemies by 10 per attribute level for 5 seconds when [Enchant Fire] is used.

20104.name: Flare
20104.description: Inflicts damage by exploding a burning enemy.

attributes.name: Flare: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Flare] by 1% per attribute level.

attributes.name: Flare: Additional Damage
attributes.effect: Increases the damage of [Flare] by 10 per attribute level to Cloth armor-type enemies.

20105.name: Fire Pillar
20105.description: Summons a pillar of fire to inflict damage on enemies.

attributes.name: Fire Pillar: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Fire Pillar] by 1% per attribute level.

20106.name: Hell Breath
20106.description: Attack by continuously fuming fire forward to enemies. Deals continuous flame damage to enemies.

attributes.name: Hell Breath: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Hell Breath] by 1% per attribute level.

attributes.name: Hell Breath: Knockback
attributes.effect: Enemies hit by [Hell Breath] have a 10% chance per attribute level of being knocked back.

20107.name: Flame Ground
20107.description: Creates a magic circle of flames at a targeted area. Deals continuous flame damage to enemies within the magic circle.

attributes.name: Flame Ground: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Flame Ground] by 1% per attribute level.

20201.name: Ice Bolt
20201.description: Cast an arrow of ice that inflicts damage and has a chance of freezing the enemy.

attributes.name: Ice Bolt: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Ice Bolt] by 1% per attribute level.

attributes.name: Ice Bolt: Chance of Freeze
attributes.effect: Increases the chance of inflicting [Freeze] on enemies hit by [Ice Bolt] by 10% per attribute level.

20202.name: Ice Pike
20202.description: Make ice spikes sprout out in a line to inflict damage. Has a chance of freezing enemies.

attributes.name: Ice Pike: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Ice Spike] by 1% per attribute level.

20203.name: Ice Wall
20203.description: Creates a wall of ice that confines an enemy with a chance of freezing nearby enemies.

attributes.name: Ice Wall: Cryorite
attributes.effect: Cryorite can be dropped with a chance of 1% per attribute level when [Ice Wall] disappears.

20204.name: Ice Blast
20204.description: Inflicts damage on a frozen enemy in front of you. There is a small chance to remove freeze from the enemy when it takes damage.

attributes.name: Ice Blast: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Ice Blast] by 1% per attribute level.

attributes.name: Ice Blast: Additional Damage
attributes.effect: Increases the damage of [Ice Blast] by 10 per attribute level when attacking Leather armor-type enemies.

20205.name: Subzero Shield
20205.description: Create a curtain of ice for defense. Inflicts damage after blocking enemy attacks and has a chance of freezing enemies.

attributes.name: Subzero Shield: Counterattack Enhance
attributes.effect: While equipped with a shield when [Subzero Shield] is active, there is an increase in counter attack damage based on your shield's defense. Counter attack damage is enhanced by 50% per attribute level.

attributes.name: Subzero Shield: Duration
attributes.effect: Increases the freeze duration of [Subzero Shield] by 0.5 seconds per attribute level.

20206.name: Gust
20206.description: Creates a strong gust of wind that pushes enemies. When inflicting damage on a frozen enemy, it will unfreeze.

attributes.name: Gust: Collision Damage
attributes.effect: [Gust] deals damage even to unfrozen enemies. Attacks unfrozen enemies 2 times and attacks frozen enemies 3 times.

20207.name: Snow Rolling
20207.description: Ride on an enormous snowball and crush any enemies in your way.

attributes.name: Snow Rolling: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Snow Rolling] by 1% per attribute level.

20208.name: Frost Pillar
20208.description: Summons a tree of ice on the ground that pulls nearby enemies in and has a chance of freezing them.

20301.name: Psychic Pressure
20301.description: Concentrate on the the tip of your hand to inflict continuous damage with psychokinesis.

attributes.name: Psychic Pressure: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Psychic Pressure] by 1% per attribute level.

attributes.name: Psychic Pressure: Stun
attributes.effect: Enemies hit by [Psychic Pressure] have a 10% chance per attribute level to become afflicted with [Stun] for 1 second.

20302.name: Telekinesis
20302.description:
Use psychokinesis to capture a target in front and throw it around.
Inflicts damage by throwing the captured target in a direction using your arrow keys.

attributes.name: Telekinesis: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Telekinesis] by 1% per attribute level.

20303.name: Swap
20303.description: Swaps your position with that of the enemy.

20305.name: Magnetic Force
20305.description: Inflict damage on multiple enemies by pulling them to a targeted area causing them to collide with each other.

attributes.name: Magnetic Force: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Magnetic Force] by 1% per attribute level.

attributes.name: Magnetic Force: Stun
attributes.effect: Enemies hit by [Magnetic Force] have a 5% chance per attribute level to become afflicted with [Stun] for 4 seconds.

20306.name: Raise
20306.description: Lift nearby enemies up into the air. Enemies in the air are temporarily detected as a Flying-type.

attributes.name: Raise: Large Monsters
attributes.effect: [Raise] applies to large-type monsters.

20307.name: Gravity Pole
20307.description: Creates a gravity field in front of you in a line that pulls nearby enemies into it.

attributes.name: Gravity Pole: Evasion
attributes.effect: Increases evasion by 10% per attribute level when using [Gravity Pole].

attributes.name: Gravity Pole: Decreased Defense
attributes.effect: Decreases the physical defense of enemies by 10% per attribute level that are pulled by [Gravity Pole].

attributes.name: Gravity Pole: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Gravity Pole] by 1% per attribute level.

attributes.name: Unbind: Enemy Damage
attributes.effect: Deals damage equal to 100% magic attack to enemies just when the link from [Unbind] is about to disconnect. Increases by 10% per attribute level from Lv. 2.

20402.name: Physical Link
20402.description: Link party members to divide damage taken.

attributes.name: Physical Link: Defense
attributes.effect: Increases physical defense equal to [connected party members + attribute level] when [Physical Link] is active.

20403.name: Joint Penalty
20403.description: Link enemies, so that they share damage taken.

attributes.name: Joint Penalty: Earth
attributes.effect: Deals 10% additional damage per attribute level of the Earth property attack to enemies affected by [Joint Penalty].

attributes.name: Joint Penalty: Lightning
attributes.effect: Deals 10% additional damage per attribute level of the Lightning property attack to enemies affected by [Joint Penalty].

attributes.name: Joint Penalty: Poison
attributes.effect: Deals 10% additional damage per attribute level of the Poison property attack to enemies affected by [Joint Penalty].

20404.name: Hangman's Knot
20404.description: Tighten the link to gather up the linked enemies in front of you.

attributes.name: Hangman's Knot: Additional Damage
attributes.effect: Enemies hit by [Hangman's Knot] will receive additional damage equal to 20% magic attack per attribute level.

attributes.name: Hangman's Knot: Splash Defense
attributes.effect: Decreases the AoE Defense Ratio of the enemies gathered through [Hangman's Knot] by 1 per attribute level.

20405.name: Spiritual Chain
20405.description: Link party members to share buff effects with each other.

attributes.name: Spiritual Chain: Duration
attributes.effect: Increases the duration of [Spiritual Chain] by 1 second per attribute level.

20406.name: Lifeline
20406.description: Uses the highest abilities between you and allies linked by [Spiritual Chain].

attributes.name: Umbilical Cord: Increased Nullification
attributes.effect: Increases the chance to nullify an enemy's attack while using [Umbilical Cord] by 2% per attribute level.

20501.name: Swell Left Arm
20501.description: Enlarge the size of you and your party member's hand to increase attack.

attributes.name: Swell Left Arm: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the attack increase effect of [Swell Left Arm] by 3 per attribute level.
attributes.requirement: Lv. 3 of Swell Left Arm: Enhance required

attributes.name: Swell Left Arm: Shrink Size Speciality
attributes.effect: Deals 35 additional damage per attribute level on enemies affected by [Shrink Body] when [Swell Left Arm] is in effect.

attributes.name: Swell Left Arm: Swell Body Speciality
attributes.effect: Attacking enemies affected by [Swell Body] when [Swell Left Arm] is in effect, causes [Attacked Weakened] to persist in duration. Increases the duration by 8 seconds per attribute level. [Attack Weakened] can be stacked up to 10 times.

20502.name: Shrink Body
20502.description: Shrink the size of your target.

attributes.name: Shrink Body: Increased Movement Speed
attributes.effect: Increases the movement speed of monsters affected by [Shrink Body] by 10%, while decreasing their physical and magic attack by 25% per attribute level. (The effects do not count towards characters.)

attributes.name: Shrink Body: Additional Damage
attributes.effect: Deals damage equal to 20% magic attack when changing the enemy's size with [Shrink Body] per attribute level.

20503.name: Swell Body
20503.description: Enlarge the size of your target. Increases the target's HP and maximum HP by its maximum HP. Doubles EXP gained and loot dropped.

attributes.name: Swell Body: Decreased Movement Speed
attributes.effect: Decreases the movement speed of monsters affected by [Swell Body] by 15%, while increasing their physical and magic attack by 20% per attribute level. (The effects do not count towards characters.)

attributes.name: Swell Body: Additional Damage
attributes.effect: Deals damage equal to 20% magic attack when changing the enemy's size with [Swell Body] per attribute level.

attributes.name: Transpose: Equilibrium
attributes.effect: Balance your INT and CON when using [Transpose], causing each to become the average of both.

20506.name: Swell Right Arm
20506.description: Temporarily enlarge your party member's offhand, increasing attack if it is equipped with a shield or dagger.

attributes.name: Swell Right Arm: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the defense and attack increase effect of [Swell Right Arm] by 3 per attribute level.

attributes.name: Swell Arm Enhance: Swiftness
attributes.effect: Not using a dagger nor a shield as an offhand gives you a 6% higher accuracy and evasion per attribute level.

20507.name: Swell Brain
20507.description: Enlarge the size of you and your party members' heads to increase INT.

attributes.name: Swell Brain: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the INT increase effect of [Swell Brain] by 2 per attribute level.

20601.name: Electrocute
20601.description: Release a surge of electricity to attack enemies in front of you.

attributes.name: Electrocute: Freezing Magic Damage
attributes.effect: Deals additional damage equal to 50% of magic attack per attribute level when using [Electrocute] on frozen enemies.

attributes.name: Electrocute: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Electrocute] by 1% per attribute level.

attributes.name: Stone Curse: Increased Petrification
attributes.effect: Increases the number of targets that can be affected by [Petrify] with [Stone Curse] by attribute level.

20603.name: Hail
20603.description: Drop chunks of ice to continuously inflict damage on enemies.

attributes.name: Hail: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Hail] by 1% per attribute level.

attributes.name: Hail: Freeze
attributes.effect: Enemies hit by [Hail] have a 5% chance per attribute level to be afflicted with [Freeze] for 5 seconds.

20604.name: Prominence
20604.description: Summons Prominence. The summoned Prominence goes back and forth randomly, inflicting damage to targets.

attributes.name: Prominence: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Prominence] by 1% per attribute level.

attributes.name: Prominence: Prominence Wandering
attributes.effect: [Prominence] wanders within a smaller range.

20605.name: Meteor
20605.description: Drop meteors on the targeted area to inflict damage to an enemy.

attributes.name: Meteor: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Meteor] by 1% per attribute level.

attributes.name: Meteor: Evasion
attributes.effect: Increases your evasion by 10% per attribute level while charging [Meteor].

20606.name: Rain
20606.description: Let it rain in a targeted area. The rain provides various effects.

attributes.name: Rain: Monsoon
attributes.effect: Has a chance to double the duration of [Rain]. Increases the chance by 5% per attribute level.

20607.name: Freezing Sphere
20607.description: Damages an enemy by throwing an Ice Sphere.

attributes.name: Freezing Sphere: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Freezing Sphere] by 1% per attribute level.

20608.name: Frost Cloud
20608.description: Creates a magic circle of ice at a targeted area. Deals continuous ice damage to enemies in the magic circle.

attributes.name: Frost Cloud: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Frost Cloud] by 1% per attribute level.

20801.name: Quicken
20801.description: Temporarily increases the attack speed of you and your party members by manipulating time.

attributes.name: Quicken: Critical Rate
attributes.effect: Increases the critical rate effect from [Quicken] by 5% and decreases evasion by 2% per attribute level.

20802.name: Reincarnate
20802.description: By manipulating time, you can let a monster appear at the same location where it was defeated.

attributes.name: Revive: Two
attributes.effect: When an enemy affected by [Reincarnate] dies and is revived, two enemies will appear with a chance of 1% per attribute level.

20803.name: Stop
20803.description: Stops time of monsters within the targeted area. Enemies do not receive damage when time is stopped.

attributes.name: Stop: Control Boss Monster
attributes.effect: [Stop] can also stop boss monsters but once released, it will not be stopped again.

attributes.name: Stop: Decreased SP
attributes.effect: Decreases the SP cost of [Stop] by 40.

20804.name: Slow
20804.description: Controls time to decrease the movement speed of enemies.

attributes.name: Slow: Critical Resistance
attributes.effect: Enemies affected by [Slow] have their critical resistance decreased by a value equal to 15% of the caster's INT.

attributes.name: Slow: Decreased Nullification
attributes.effect: Decreases the chance of nullifying an attack by 6% per attribute level when enemies are affected by [Slow].

20805.name: Haste
20805.description: Temporarily increases the movement speed of you and your party members by manipulating time.

attributes.name: Haste: Increased Evasion
attributes.effect: Increases your evasion by 20 per attribute level while [Haste] is active.

20806.name: Backmasking
20806.description: Control time in an area, temporarily changing it back to its previous state.

attributes.name: Backmasking: Confusion
attributes.effect: Enemies provoked after using [Backmasking] will be afflicted with [Confusion] for 6 seconds. If the attribute is Lv2, 8 seconds of [Confusion] will be applied.

20807.name: Pass
20807.description: Reduces the cooldown of skills of you and your party members.
